formula_explanation: The Fixed Deposit Calculator uses the following mathematical formula: FD Maturity: A = P × (1 + r/n)^(nt)  where P = principal, r = annual rate, n = compounding frequency per year, t = years; Simple Interest FD: A = P × (1 + r×t). example_calculation: Example: FD ₹1 lakh at 7% p.a. for 3 years (quarterly compounding) → Maturity ≈ ₹1,23,145; Interest = ₹23,145.

important_notes: Interest rates shown are indicative. Actual rates change based on RBI policy and bank decisions. TDS applicable if interest exceeds ₹40,000/year (₹50,000 for senior citizens).
